evidence.title: NULL rate spike on transaction_amount
evidence.excerpt: Anomaly detected on transactions_fact.transaction_amount: NULL rate is 45.2% (Historical average: 0.01%).

evidence.title: Unrecognized currency format
evidence.excerpt: Encountered 452,000 records with unrecognized currency format. Defaulting to NULL for transaction_amount.

hypotheses.statement: The root cause is a currency format parsing issue in the payment gateway API where unrecognized currency formats are causing transaction_amount fields to be set to NULL, leading to elevated NULL rates and downstream data quality failures.

impacts.reason: Depends on Payment API which is outputting invalid currency format, leading to NULL transaction_amount in downstream data.
Halted due to upstream data quality failure on transactions_fact (NULL transaction_amount).
Failed to build due to stale data because upstream transactions_fact has NULL transaction_amount.

action_plan.rationale: The root cause is a data quality issue in the payment gateway API where unrecognized currency formats are causing transaction_amount fields to be NULL. Fixing the currency format handling and reprocessing affected data will restore normal operations.
action_plan.expected_outcome: Payment gateway API will correctly handle currency formats, transaction_amount will be populated correctly, and downstream jobs will resume normal processing.

steps.action: Fix currency format parsing logic in payment gateway API to handle unrecognized currency formats
Identify and correct affected transactions_fact records with NULL transaction_amount
Reprocess dependent downstream jobs: JOB_FINANCIAL_REPORTING and transactions_fact_daily_summary
Validate data quality after reprocessing to ensure transaction_amount accuracy
Monitor NULL rate for transaction_amount to confirm return to baseline (<0.1%)
